decisions.evidence: Overall, the moderate QED, large surface area, polar heterocyclic content, and tertiary hydroxyl create absorption liabilities, but the favorable indole and the limited number of basic sites, together with a TPSA that is not prohibitive, are enough to support the conclusion of oral bioavailability ≥ 20%.
overall nearest-neighbor evidence supports option (B): has oral bioavailability ≥ 20%.
